question: What arises when one knows that hidden true nature?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature causes all-knowingness.
The verse states arising of all-knowingness.
inference: All-knowingness arises from knowing that hidden true nature.
uncertainties: Exact internal compound parsing of gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ remains uncertain.
plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
